title_en: Garment workers protest in Mirpur, Gazipur demanding wage hike, wage board formed
title_bn: মজুরি বৃদ্ধির দাবিতে মিরপুর, গাজীপুরে পোশাক শ্রমিকদের বিক্ষোভ, মজুরি বোর্ড গঠন
summary_en: Garment workers are protesting for the second day in Mirpur and Gazipur, Dhaka, demanding a minimum wage of Tk 30,000. In Mirpur, a car was set on fire after a clash between garment workers and police. The government has formed a wage board. Details are available on BBC Bangla's live page...
